title: Reorganize String
description:
Given a string s, rearrange the characters of s so that any two adjacent characters are not the same.
Return any possible rearrangement of s or return "" if not possible.
 
Example 1:
Input: s = "aab"
Output: "aba"
Example 2:
Input: s = "aaab"
Output: ""

 
Constraints:

1 <= s.length <= 500
s consists of lowercase English letters.

    assert (lambda ans: not (sorted(ans) < sorted("aab") or sorted(ans) > sorted("aab")) and all(ans[i] != ans[i + 1] for i in range(len(ans) - 1)))(candidate(s = "aab"))
    assert not candidate(s = "aaab")
